title: CanFlyHere - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script

Can this actor fly here?

Syntax:
bool Function CanFlyHere() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
Whether this actor can fly here or not.

Examples:
; Can Nate fly here?
bool nateCanFlyHere = Nate.CanFlyHere()
